source_policy: all26source reward strings are blank; preserve blank unchanged. Local explicit XP/practice/silver adopts completion incentive, not a recovered official reward; no default0 or implied missing original items. Other121source rewards untouched.
scope: only final reward definitions for26blank rows; not147semantic quest adoption or all advancement rewards

authoring_rule.level: source conditions explicit required level,never current delivery level
authoring_rule.experience: floor(level_table.xp_to_next_level/20),a local5%level budget; pinned below,not recalculated using delivery-time character or mutable config
authoring_rule.practice: floor(level_table.xp_to_next_level/200),explicit independent reward,not inferred from capped XP credit
authoring_rule.items: explicit local no-item reward; original source items unknown,not proof original quest gave none
authoring_rule.progression: no rank/route/ability grant invented from reward blank; real formal task may have separate progression result requiring explicit adoption decision

transaction_policy.inputs: deduct exact final stage inputs and verify final NPC/distance/alive/out-of-combat/challenge rules as each formal quest defines; missing quest schema rejects,never infer inputs from these rewards
transaction_policy.xp_cap: 14personal experience cap; preview actual credit and loss,explicitly confirm; no overflow bank or transfer to team
transaction_policy.practice_silver_caps: check17full balances after fees/inputs before commit; unable to hold full reward rejects whole delivery,never clamp partial
transaction_policy.modifiers: task completion reward excluded from team pool,26finisher/training buffs; supreme-service task applicability must be explicit future decision,not inherited from monster modifier
transaction_policy.receipt: final base/actual/lostXP,practice,silver,source reward definition,round and revisions one durable settlement; replay returns same result,no reroll/recredit
transaction_policy.new_source_evidence: preserve existing source and issued receipts; any changed adoption needs explicit config/version decision,never retroactively generate another reward
transaction_policy.save_failure: same business commit retained for save retry; no second delivery or source reward addition
